content.thinking:
Question results without details fall back to resultText, which seems fine since missing details would only realistically occur on error results anyway (interrupted/aborted cases), so this is minor hardening rather than a real gap. I'm also noting that a question result summary could nicely say "question posted" as a small improvement, and I still need to check truncation behavior for details.

I'm confirming truncated values still expose details.value per the tests, that harness-written errors correctly rely on text-only, and that syntax errors in getFunctionDependencies return gracefully instead of throwing. I'm also checking that saveOnly function titles derive from the first code line, that tool wrapping doesn't strip the `present` field since useTools reads extension.tools directly, and that call.arguments match what the model actually sent. Dependency list summaries staying under pi-action's 120-char line limit seems fine too, though I should verify whether PR #82 has merged since pit's docs link depends on it. Overall the implementation looks solid, with just a few small fixes worth requesting, starting with guarding against details not being a record.

Beyond that, I want to suggest hardening the result() ord lookup to fall back with a warning instead of throwing when details are missing, guarding the savedFunction string in saveOnly summaries, and giving call() a fallback title (like the functionId) when the title would otherwise be blank. I'm also considering a nice-to-have where question results show "asked: <title>" instead of a dependency list. The pi-action version bump to pit v0.36.4 is separate work that should wait until PR #82 merges, so I'll keep this review scoped and focus on posting the fix requests to @pi on cv/pit#372, retrying if the earlier comment attempt failed due to permissions.
The missing-details crash only shows up with odd inputs, but saveOnly and empty-title are genuine contract gaps. Posting the review on cv/pit#372 now.
